name: Imagenae: Holy Grail War
description:
A golden rain falls. A Holy Grail, stolen. Somewhere in the shadows beyond the Phantasmoon's reach, a certain king's treasury has unexpectedly shattered into shambles.
To prevent chaos, you'll have no choice but to team up with Rin Tohsaka, a mage from another world, to restore order, and while you're at it, to claim your own share of the treasure.
introduction:
▌ The collaboration characters have no English voiceovers. You may switch to another voiceover language if preferred.

▌ "Imagenae: Holy Grail War"
● A golden rain falls. A Holy Grail, stolen. Somewhere in the shadows beyond the Phantasmoon's reach, you'll step onto the battlefield of the Imagenae Holy Grail War, accompanied by Rin Tohsaka, a mage from another world...

▌ "Fate/Star Rail Night"
◆ Event Rules ◆
● In "Fate/Star Rail Night," the Trailblazer joins the Imagenae Holy Grail War, gathering scattered Treasures and heading into battle equipped with Conceptual Mystic Codes.

◆ Permanent Rewards ◆
● Complete permanent missions in "Fate/Star Rail Night" to obtain permanent rewards.

◆ Limited-Time Rewards ◆
● During the limited-time event, complete limited-time missions in "Fate/Star Rail Night" to obtain limited-time rewards.

◆ Event Reminder ◆
● After the "Fate/Star Rail Night" limited-time event ends, Trailblazers will no longer be able to obtain the limited-time rewards, but they can still visit the Dovebrook District to experience the event and obtain permanent rewards.

▌ Fate Gift
● During the event, Trailblazers who consume a cumulative total of 200 Star Rail Special Passes across any Version 4.4 Warp event can claim the reward after the Collaboration Warp begins.
● The total number of "Star Rail Special Passes" consumed is shared across all Warp events in Version 4.4.
● This reward can only be claimed once during the event.
